caption: The drawing depicts two adjacent, similarly shaped objects, each with an elongated, curved form and a circular opening at both ends. The object on the left is decorated with a detailed blue and white pattern that includes floral and geometric elements, as well as a yellow central motif near the upper part; it is partially outlined and shaded in brown, giving it a dimensional effect. The object on the right has a similar outline and is predominantly brown in color, with shading suggesting the same dimensionality but lacking the decorative patterns of the left object. The two objects partially overlap near their upper regions. The background is a plain off-white, and there is a handwritten signature or notation “A. Regli” in the lower right corner.
